title: OPTiM begins a trial of its “AI Physical Security Service” AI camera monitoring at two JR Kyushu stations, Wajiro and Futajima, from 10 October 2017
summary: OPTiM's release says its cloud AI monitors station camera video in real time, recognizing people, trains and the platform yellow line, and alerts administrators on anomalies; no results published.
account: OPTiM Corporation announced on 6 October 2017 that from 10 October 2017 it would run a demonstration trial of its “AI Physical Security Service” at two Kyushu Railway Company (JR Kyushu) stations, 和白駅 (Wajiro) on the Kashii Line and 二島駅 (Futajima) on the Chikuho Main Line. The service, which runs on “OPTiM Cloud IoT OS”, has AI monitor network-camera video in real time and, when it detects an anomaly, shows an alert and emails administrators, to reduce the burden on operators who watch many monitors and to raise safety in the station; the release includes an image of station camera analysis identifying people, trains and the yellow platform line. The release is the only source (on optim.co.jp and republished by @Press); JR Kyushu is not quoted, no trial end date, detection target list or result is given, and no later report of outcomes was found. The date observed is the trial start date. Station romanisations are ours.
purpose: Trial of AI video monitoring to detect anomalies on station platforms and alert administrators; no detection event is documented.
system: AI Physical Security Service (AI surveillance-camera service on OPTiM Cloud IoT OS)
deployer: Kyushu Railway Company (JR Kyushu), trial at two stations
location: Wajiro (Kashii Line) and Futajima (Chikuho Main Line) stations, JR Kyushu, Japan
taxonomy_note: Loose fit; a trial announcement with no result, whose stated aims are station safety alerts and a lighter monitoring load for operators.

ratings.reason: Only OPTiM's announcement exists; no trial result, alert count or staffing effect was published.
No passenger safety outcome is documented.

ai_role.statement: No event is reported; the AI's role is described only in the vendor's launch release (real-time video monitoring, anomaly alerts, email to administrators), and no account from JR Kyushu was found.

headline: OPTiM trials AI camera monitoring at two JR Kyushu stations

later.note: OPTiM announced on 26 June 2018 that a trial of the same service with Itec Hankyu Hanshin at JR Sawa station on the Joban Line achieved a 96.2% detection rate of people or objects crossing the platform's yellow line while no train was present, against a 90% target; no result for the JR Kyushu stations was found.
later.quote: オプティム< 3694 >は26日、アイテック阪急阪神(本社:大阪府大阪市)と共同でJR常盤線佐和駅において、オプティムが提供する「AI Physical Security Service」の実証実験を実施し、目標を上回る検知率96.2％を達成したと発表。今回、目標として設定した検知率(電車が駅に不在時に、ホーム際の黄色い線より線路側に人もしくは物体が侵入した際にAIが検知した割合)は90％としていた。
